-- Persistent platform listeners; star views are disposed by the controller.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local Marketplace=game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Input=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local StarterGui=game:GetService("StarterGui")
local Kit=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("ClickerKit")
local Rules=require(Kit.MonetizationRules)
local Offers=require(Kit.MonetizationCatalog)
local Controller=require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("StarClientController"))
local Remotes=Kit:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local connections,alive={},true
local controller
local function connect(signal,fn)
    local c=signal:Connect(fn);table.insert(connections,c);return c
end
local function promptOffer(key,c)
    local row=c.View.ShopOffers[key];local s=c.State
    if not row or not s or c.Checkout or c.PendingTransition or s.TransactionBusy then return end
    local offer=row.Offer
    local owned=offer.Kind=="Pass" and s.OwnedPasses and s.OwnedPasses[key]==true or false
    local active=offer.Grant and offer.Grant.Type=="PaidBoost" and(s.PaidBoostEndsAt or 0)>workspace:GetServerTimeNow() or false
    local canFit=not offer.Grant or offer.Grant.Type~="Currency" or(s.Currency or 0)+offer.Grant.Amount<=c.View.Config.MaximumCurrency
    local decision=Rules.OfferState(offer,c.Prices[key]~=nil,owned,active,canFit,
        offer.Kind~="Product" or s.CanSellDeveloperProducts~=false,s.DeveloperProductsUnavailableReason)
    if not decision.CanPrompt then
        local messages={WalletFull="Spend some Energy before buying another pack.",
            PersistenceUnavailable="Purchases need cloud saving. Rejoin a published server with saving enabled.",
            StorageLimit="Purchases are paused because receipt history is near its storage limit.",
            Owned="You already own this pass."}
        c:Toast(messages[decision.Status] or "Roblox has not returned a price for this offer yet.");return
    end
    c:SetCheckout(true)
    local ok=pcall(function()
        if offer.Kind=="Pass" then Marketplace:PromptGamePassPurchase(player,offer.Id)
        else Marketplace:PromptProductPurchase(player,offer.Id)end
    end)
    if not ok then c:SetCheckout(false);c:Toast("Roblox could not open the purchase prompt. Please try again.")end
end
controller=Controller.new(player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"),{
    SendAction=function(...)Remotes.RequestAction:FireServer(...)end,PromptOffer=promptOffer})
connect(Remotes.StateUpdate.OnClientEvent,function(s)controller:ApplySnapshot(s)end)
connect(Input.InputBegan,function(input,processed)
    if not processed and(input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Space or input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA)then controller:Click()end
    if(input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
        and controller:OverWorldList(input)then controller:CancelWorldScroll();controller:UpdateWorldScrollButtons()end
end)
connect(Input.InputChanged,function(input)
    if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel and controller:OverWorldList(input)then
        controller:CancelWorldScroll();controller:UpdateWorldScrollButtons()
    end
end)
connect(Marketplace.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished,function(who)
    if who==player then controller:SetCheckout(false)end
end)
connect(Marketplace.PromptProductPurchaseFinished,function(userId)
    if userId==player.UserId then controller:SetCheckout(false)end
end)
for key,row in pairs(controller.View.ShopOffers)do
    local offer=row.Offer
    if offer.Id>0 then task.spawn(function()
        local ok,info=pcall(function()return Marketplace:GetProductInfoAsync(offer.Id,
            offer.Kind=="Pass" and Enum.InfoType.GamePass or Enum.InfoType.Product)end)
        if alive and ok and type(info)=="table" and type(info.PriceInRobux)=="number"then controller:SetPrice(key,info.PriceInRobux)end
    end)end
end
local viewportConnection
local function setCamera()
    local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
    if camera then
        camera.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
        camera.CFrame=CFrame.new(0,100,0)*CFrame.Angles(-math.pi/2,0,0)
        controller:SetViewport(camera.ViewportSize)
    end
end
local function connectCamera()
    if viewportConnection then viewportConnection:Disconnect()end
    setCamera()
    if workspace.CurrentCamera then viewportConnection=workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(setCamera)end
end
connect(workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"),connectCamera);connectCamera()
pcall(function()
    for _,kind in ipairs({Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack,Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList,Enum.CoreGuiType.Chat,Enum.CoreGuiType.Health})do
        StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(kind,false)
    end
end)
task.spawn(function()
    local module=player:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts"):WaitForChild("PlayerModule",10)
    if module and alive then
        local ok,controls=pcall(function()return require(module):GetControls()end)
        if ok and alive then controls:Disable()end
    end
end)
task.spawn(function()
    local previous=os.clock()
    while alive do
        task.wait(Rules.AutoTapInterval)
        if not alive then break end
        local now=os.clock();controller:AutoTapStep(now-previous);previous=now
    end
end)
connect(script.Destroying,function()
    alive=false
    for _,c in ipairs(connections)do c:Disconnect()end
    if viewportConnection then viewportConnection:Disconnect()end
    controller:Destroy()
end)
Remotes.RequestSnapshot:FireServer()
task.spawn(function()
    for _=1,20 do
        if controller.State or not alive then return end
        task.wait(1)
        if alive then Remotes.RequestSnapshot:FireServer()end
    end
    if alive and not controller.State then controller:Toast("Connection delayed. Please rejoin.")end
end)

local function create(providedConfig)
-- Bounded client-only animation. Rewards and timers remain authoritative on the server.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local Kit = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("ClickerKit")
local Config = providedConfig or require(Kit.ThemeConfig)
local Art = require(Kit.Art).ForConfig(Config)
local T = Config.Theme
local Effects = {}
Effects.__index = Effects
local AudioCues = {
    Hover = { Id = "rbxassetid://85648618766955", Volume = 0.12 },
    Click = { Id = "rbxassetid://107136159030257", Volume = 0.24 },
    Confirm = { Id = "rbxassetid://134961823627800", Volume = 0.30 },
    Reward = { Id = "rbxassetid://104547582381900", Volume = 0.42 },
    Locked = { Id = "rbxassetid://113836048255506", Volume = 0.24 },
}
local NoticeCues = {
    Purchase = "Reward",
    Research = "Reward",
    World = "Reward",
    Expedition = "Confirm",
    Burst = "Confirm",
    Reward = "Reward",
    Achievement = "Reward",
    Collect = "Reward",
    Rebirth = "Reward",
    Error = "Locked",
}
local function playCue(name)
    local cue = AudioCues[name]
    if not cue then
        return
    end
    local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    sound.Name = "Orbit" .. name
    sound.SoundId = cue.Id
    sound.Volume = cue.Volume
    sound.Parent = SoundService
    sound:Play()
    Debris:AddItem(sound, 4)
end
local function createMusic()
    local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    sound.Name = "OrbitBackgroundMusic"
    sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://128127190999486"
    sound.Looped = true
    sound.Volume = 0.22
    sound.Parent = SoundService
    sound:Play()
    return sound
end
function Effects:PlayCue(name)
    if name == "Hover" then
        local now = os.clock()
        if now < self.NextHoverSound then
            return
        end
        self.NextHoverSound = now + 0.08
    end
    playCue(name)
end
local function circle(parent, name, color, size)
    local o = Instance.new("Frame")
    o.Name = name
    o.BorderSizePixel = 0
    o.BackgroundColor3 = color
    o.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
    o.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    corner.Parent = o
    o.Parent = parent
    return o
end
function Effects.new(view)
    local self = setmetatable({
        View = view,
        Spring = 1,
        Velocity = 0,
        Tilt = 0,
        Hover = false,
        Time = 0,
        Accumulator = 0,
        Display = 0,
        Particles = 0,
        Collectors = {},
        PassiveClock = 0,
        Clouds = {},
        CachedArt = nil,
        ButtonConnections = {},
        ButtonFeedback = {},
        NextHoverSound = 0,
    }, Effects)
    self.Music = createMusic()
    view.Animated = true
    view.Target.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        self.Hover = true
        self:PlayCue("Hover")
    end)
    view.Target.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        self.Hover = false
    end)
    local function animateButton(record, target, style, duration)
        if view.ReducedMotion then
            target = 1
        end
        if record.Tween then
            record.Tween:Cancel()
            record.Tween = nil
        end
        local tween = TweenService:Create(
            record.Scale,
            TweenInfo.new(duration, style, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Scale = target }
        )
        record.Tween = tween
        tween.Completed:Once(function()
            if record.Tween == tween then
                record.Tween = nil
            end
        end)
        tween:Play()
        return tween
    end
    local function hoverScale(record)
        return record.Hovered and not view.ReducedMotion and 1.025 or 1
    end
    for _, control in ipairs(view.Gui:GetDescendants()) do
        if control:IsA("GuiButton") and control ~= view.Target and control ~= view.Modal then
            local scale = control:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
            if not scale then
                scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
                scale.Name = "OrbitInteractionScale"
                scale.Parent = control
            end
            local record = { Control = control, Scale = scale, Hovered = false, Tween = nil }
            table.insert(self.ButtonFeedback, record)
            table.insert(
                self.ButtonConnections,
                control.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                    record.Hovered = true
                    self:PlayCue("Hover")
                    animateButton(record, hoverScale(record), Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.12)
                end)
            )
            table.insert(
                self.ButtonConnections,
                control.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                    record.Hovered = false
                    animateButton(record, 1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.12)
                end)
            )
            table.insert(
                self.ButtonConnections,
                control.Activated:Connect(function()
                    self:PlayCue("Click")
                    if view.ReducedMotion then
                        return
                    end
                    local press = animateButton(record, 0.95, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.06)
                    press.Completed:Once(function(playbackState)
                        if playbackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and record.Control.Parent then
                            animateButton(record, hoverScale(record), Enum.EasingStyle.Back, 0.16)
                        end
                    end)
                end)
            )
        end
    end
    if view.Motion then
        table.insert(
            self.ButtonConnections,
            view.Motion.Activated:Connect(function()
                task.defer(function()
                    for _, record in ipairs(self.ButtonFeedback) do
                        if record.Tween then
                            record.Tween:Cancel()
                            record.Tween = nil
                        end
                        record.Scale.Scale = hoverScale(record)
                    end
                end)
            end)
        )
    end
    self.Connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        self.Accumulator += dt
        if self.Accumulator >= 1 / 30 then
            local elapsed = self.Accumulator
            self.Accumulator = 0
            self:Step(math.min(elapsed, 0.05))
        end
    end)
    view.Gui.Destroying:Once(function()
        self:Destroy()
    end)
    return self
end
function Effects:Track(object, life)
    self.Particles += 1
    object.Destroying:Once(function()
        self.Particles = math.max(0, self.Particles - 1)
    end)
    Debris:AddItem(object, life + 0.2)
end
function Effects:Pop(message, color, x, y, big)
    if self.Particles >= 70 then
        return
    end
    local v = self.View
    local o = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    o.Name = "RewardPop"
    o.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    o.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    o.Text = message
    o.TextColor3 = color or T.Accent
    o.TextSize = big and 25 or 18
    o.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 34)
    o.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    o.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x or v.Target.Position.X.Offset, y or v.Target.Position.Y.Offset - 50)
    o.ZIndex = 10
    o.Parent = v.Particles
    self:Track(o, 0.8)
    TweenService:Create(
        o,
        TweenInfo.new(0.75, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        { Position = o.Position - UDim2.fromOffset(0, v.ReducedMotion and 8 or 48), TextTransparency = 1 }
    ):Play()
end
function Effects:Press()
    local v = self.View
    self:PlayCue("Click")
    self.Spring = v.ReducedMotion and 0.98 or 0.91
    self.Velocity = -0.4
    self.Tilt = math.random(-2, 2)
    if v.ReducedMotion or self.Particles >= 60 then
        return
    end
    local d = v.Diameter or 250
    local p = v.Target.Position
    local ring = circle(v.Particles, "ClickRipple", T.Accent, d * 0.87)
    ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    ring.Position = p
    ring.ZIndex = 8
    local line = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    line.Color = T.Accent
    line.Transparency = 0.4
    line.Thickness = 2
    line.Parent = ring
    self:Track(ring, 0.45)
    TweenService:Create(
        ring,
        TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d * 1.25, d * 1.25) }
    ):Play()
    TweenService:Create(line, TweenInfo.new(0.4), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
    for i = 1, 3 do
        local a = math.random() * math.pi * 2
        local radius = d * 0.49
        local x = p.X.Offset + math.cos(a) * radius
        local y = p.Y.Offset + math.sin(a) * radius
        local dot = circle(v.Particles, "ClickSpark", i == 1 and T.Accent or T.Text, math.random(3, 6))
        dot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
        self:Track(dot, 0.45)
        TweenService:Create(dot, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x + math.cos(a) * 25, y + math.sin(a) * 25),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1),
        }):Play()
    end
end
function Effects:Celebrate(strength)
    local v = self.View
    if v.ReducedMotion then
        return
    end
    for i = 1, math.min(strength or 14, 24) do
        if self.Particles >= 70 then
            break
        end
        local a = i / (strength or 14) * math.pi * 2
        local r = (v.Diameter or 250) * 0.55
        local x, y = v.Target.Position.X.Offset, v.Target.Position.Y.Offset
        local dot = circle(v.Particles, "Celebration", i % 2 == 0 and T.Accent or T.AccentAlt, math.random(5, 9))
        dot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
        dot.Rotation = i * 20
        self:Track(dot, 1)
        TweenService:Create(dot, TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x + math.cos(a) * r, y + math.sin(a) * r),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Rotation = dot.Rotation + 100,
        }):Play()
    end
end
function Effects:Update(previous, state)
    local v = self.View
    if previous and state.NoticeSerial ~= previous.NoticeSerial then
        local cue = NoticeCues[state.NoticeKind]
        if cue then
            self:PlayCue(cue)
        end
    end
    if not previous then
        self.Display = state.Currency
    end
    if previous and state.Currency < previous.Currency then
        self.Display = state.Currency
    end
    if previous then
        for id, item in pairs(state.Upgrades) do
            if item.Owned > ((previous.Upgrades[id] or {}).Owned or 0) then
                local row = v.Rows[id]
                local tile = row and row.Frame:FindFirstChild("IconTile")
                if tile then
                    local scale = tile:FindFirstChild("Pulse") or Instance.new("UIScale")
                    scale.Name = "Pulse"
                    scale.Parent = tile
                    scale.Scale = v.ReducedMotion and 0.98 or 0.8
                    TweenService
                        :Create(
                            scale,
                            TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                            { Scale = 1 }
                        )
                        :Play()
                end
            end
        end
        if state.CurrentZone ~= previous.CurrentZone or state.Prestiges > previous.Prestiges then
            self:Celebrate(20)
        end
        if state.BurstEndsAt > previous.BurstEndsAt then
            self:Celebrate(12)
        end
    end
    local count = 0
    for _, def in ipairs(require(Kit.UpgradeCatalog)) do
        if def.PassivePerSecond > 0 then
            count += ((state.Upgrades[def.Id] or {}).Owned or 0)
        end
    end
    count = math.min(4, count)
    for i = #self.Collectors + 1, count do
        local o = Instance.new("Frame")
        o.Name = "ActiveCollector" .. i
        o.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        o.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 48)
        o.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        o.Parent = v.CollectorLayer
        local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
        scale.Scale = 0.62
        scale.Parent = o
        if T.CollectorStyle == "Cookie" then
            local cookie = circle(o, "Cookie", T.Accent, 32)
            cookie.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
            for _, p in ipairs({ { 17, 18 }, { 28, 28 }, { 17, 30 } }) do
                local chip = circle(o, "Chip", Color3.fromRGB(79, 47, 37), 5)
                chip.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p[1], p[2])
            end
        else
            Art.Icon(o, "Drone", T.AccentAlt)
        end
        table.insert(self.Collectors, o)
    end
    for i = #self.Collectors, count + 1, -1 do
        self.Collectors[i]:Destroy()
        table.remove(self.Collectors, i)
    end
end
function Effects:Step(dt)
    local v = self.View
    if not v.Gui.Parent then
        self:Destroy()
        return
    end
    self.Time += dt
    local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
    local s = v.State
    local reduced = v.ReducedMotion
    v:UpdatePaidBoostTimer(now)
    local desired = 1 + (self.Hover and not reduced and 0.025 or 0)
    self.Velocity += ((desired - self.Spring) * 240 - self.Velocity * 23) * dt
    self.Spring = math.clamp(self.Spring + self.Velocity * dt, 0.85, 1.08)
    v.Bounce.Scale = self.Spring
    self.Tilt *= math.exp(-8 * dt)
    if v.Art ~= self.CachedArt then
        self.CachedArt = v.Art
        self.Clouds = {}
        self.PulseBeams = v.Art:FindFirstChild("PulseBeams")
        self.PulseRing = v.Art:FindFirstChild("PulseRing")
        self.AccretionRing = v.Art:FindFirstChild("AccretionRing")
        self.InnerAccretion = v.Art:FindFirstChild("InnerAccretion")
        for _, o in ipairs(v.Art:GetChildren()) do
            if o.Name == "Cloud" then
                table.insert(self.Clouds, { Object = o, Position = o.Position })
            end
        end
    end
    v.Art.Rotation = reduced and 0 or math.sin(self.Time * 0.45) * 1.2 + self.Tilt
    v.Art.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, reduced and 0 or math.sin(self.Time * 0.8) * 3)
    if self.PulseBeams then
        self.PulseBeams.Rotation = reduced and 18 or self.Time * 22
        self.PulseBeams.JetGlow.BackgroundTransparency = reduced and 0.48 or 0.38 + math.sin(self.Time * 3) * 0.12
    end
    if self.PulseRing then
        self.PulseRing.Outline.Transparency = reduced and 0.4 or 0.45 + math.sin(self.Time * 3) * 0.2
    end
    if self.AccretionRing then
        self.AccretionRing.Rotation = reduced and -22 or -22 + math.sin(self.Time * 0.7) * 8
        self.AccretionRing.Outline.Transparency = reduced and 0.1 or 0.18 + math.sin(self.Time * 2) * 0.08
        self.InnerAccretion.Rotation = reduced and -22 or -22 - math.sin(self.Time * 0.7) * 6
    end
    local angle = reduced and 0.8 or self.Time * 0.6
    v.OrbitDot.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + math.cos(angle) * 0.49, 0.5 + math.sin(angle) * 0.49)
    for _, star in ipairs(v.Stars) do
        star.Object.BackgroundTransparency = reduced and star.Alpha
            or math.clamp(star.Alpha + math.sin(self.Time * 0.7 + star.Phase) * 0.15, 0.1, 0.92)
    end
    for i, cloud in ipairs(self.Clouds) do
        cloud.Object.Position = cloud.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(reduced and 0 or math.sin(self.Time * 0.3 + i) * 2, 0)
    end
    for i, o in ipairs(self.Collectors) do
        local a = (reduced and 0 or self.Time * 0.45) + i * math.pi / 2
        o.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
            v.Target.Position.X.Offset + math.cos(a) * (v.Diameter or 250) * 0.64,
            v.Target.Position.Y.Offset + math.sin(a) * (v.Diameter or 250) * 0.35
        )
        o.Rotation = reduced and 0 or math.sin(a) * 9
    end
    if not s then
        return
    end
    local active = (s.BurstEndsAt or 0) > now
    local rate = (s.BasePassiveRate or s.PassiveRate or 0) * (active and (s.BurstMultiplier or 3) or 1)
    local estimate =
        math.min(Config.MaximumCurrency, s.Currency + rate * math.clamp(now - (s.ServerTime or now), 0, 1.1))
    self.Display += (estimate - self.Display) * (1 - math.exp(-12 * dt))
    if math.abs(estimate - self.Display) < 0.01 then
        self.Display = estimate
    end
    v.Currency.Text = Art.Number(self.Display)
    local fraction = active and math.clamp((s.BurstEndsAt - now) / (s.BurstDuration or 6), 0, 1)
        or (s.BurstCharge or 0) / (s.BurstNeeded or 20)
    v.BurstFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(fraction, 1)
    v.BurstTitle.Text = (T.BurstName or "BOOST") .. (active and " / x" .. (s.BurstMultiplier or 3) or " CHARGE")
    v.BurstCount.Text = active and string.format("%.1fs", s.BurstEndsAt - now)
        or (s.BurstCharge or 0) .. " / " .. (s.BurstNeeded or 20)
    v.BurstNote.Text = active and "All clicks and producers earn x3!" or "20 clicks unlock a short x3 production boost"
    local halo = v.Art:FindFirstChild("Atmosphere")
    if halo and halo:FindFirstChild("Outline") then
        halo.Outline.Transparency = active and (reduced and 0.35 or 0.35 + math.sin(self.Time * 5) * 0.1) or 0.75
    end
    v.Comet.Visible = (s.EventEndsAt or 0) > now
    if v.Comet.Visible then
        v.Comet.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
            v.Compact and 80 or 388,
            (v.Landscape and 50 or 75) + (reduced and 0 or math.sin(self.Time * 2) * 7)
        )
        v.Comet.Rotation = reduced and 0 or math.sin(self.Time * 2) * 4
        v.CometTimer.Text = math.ceil(s.EventEndsAt - now) .. "s / TAP TO COLLECT"
    end
    self.PassiveClock += dt
    if rate > 0 and self.PassiveClock >= 1.2 and v.Scene.Visible then
        self.PassiveClock = 0
        local o = self.Collectors[1]
        if o then
            self:Pop(
                "+" .. Art.Number(rate) .. " / sec",
                T.AccentAlt,
                o.Position.X.Offset,
                o.Position.Y.Offset - 15,
                false
            )
        end
    end
    v:UpdateExpeditions(now)
end
function Effects:Destroy()
    if self.Music then
        self.Music:Stop()
        self.Music:Destroy()
        self.Music = nil
    end
    if self.Connection then
        self.Connection:Disconnect()
        self.Connection = nil
    end
    for _, connection in ipairs(self.ButtonConnections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    for _, record in ipairs(self.ButtonFeedback) do
        if record.Tween then
            record.Tween:Cancel()
            record.Tween = nil
        end
    end

                d.Runtime.OwnedPasses[key] = saved.OwnedPasses[key]
            end
        end
    end
    d.PaidBoostEndsAt = number(saved.PaidBoostEndsAt, 0, 1e18)
    d.EquippedCosmetic = type(saved.EquippedCosmetic) == "string"
            and MonetizationCatalog.Cosmetics[saved.EquippedCosmetic]
            and saved.EquippedCosmetic
        or nil
    if type(saved.ProcessedReceipts) == "table" then
        for purchaseId, receipt in pairs(saved.ProcessedReceipts) do
            local effect = type(receipt) == "table" and receipt.Effect
            local validEffect = type(effect) == "table"
                and (
                    (effect.Type == "Currency" and finite(effect.Amount) and effect.Amount > 0)
                    or (effect.Type == "PaidBoost" and finite(effect.EndsAt) and effect.EndsAt > 0)
                )
            if
                type(purchaseId) == "string"
                and #purchaseId > 0
                and #purchaseId <= 128
                and type(receipt) == "table"
                and receipt.Status == "Granted"
                and receipt.PurchaseId == purchaseId
                and validEffect
            then
                d.ProcessedReceipts[purchaseId] = clone(receipt)
            end
        end
    end
    d.Runtime.ReceiptLedgerBytes = #HttpService:JSONEncode(d.ProcessedReceipts)
    if type(saved.Expedition) == "table" then
        local def = find(self.P.Expeditions, saved.Expedition.Id)
        if def then
            d.Expedition = {
                Id = def.Id,
                EndsAt = number(saved.Expedition.EndsAt, now, now + def.Duration),
                Reward = number(saved.Expedition.Reward, 0, self.Config.MaximumCurrency),
            }
        end
    end
    local daily = saved.Daily
    if type(daily) == "table" and daily.Day == d.Daily.Day then
        if type(daily.Baseline) == "table" then
            for metric, total in pairs({
                Clicks = d.TotalClicks,
                Purchases = d.LifetimePurchases,
                Trips = d.TotalExpeditions,
            }) do
                d.Daily.Baseline[metric] = number(daily.Baseline[metric], total, total)
            end
        end
        for _, a in ipairs(self.P.Daily) do
            if type(daily.Claimed) == "table" and daily.Claimed[a.Id] == true then
                d.Daily.Claimed[a.Id] = true
            end
        end
    else
        self:ResetDaily(d, now)
    end
    return d
end
function Economy:ResetDaily(d, now)
    d.Daily = {
        Day = math.floor(now / 86400),
        Baseline = { Clicks = d.TotalClicks, Purchases = d.LifetimePurchases, Trips = d.TotalExpeditions },
        Claimed = {},
    }
end
function Economy:Serialize(d, now)
    local result = { Version = 2, LastSeen = now }
    for _, k in ipairs({
        "Currency",
        "LifetimeCurrency",
        "RunEarned",
        "TotalClicks",
        "LifetimePurchases",
        "TotalExpeditions",
        "Prestiges",
        "Stars",
        "CurrentZone",
    }) do
        result[k] = d[k]
    end
    for _, k in ipairs({ "Upgrades", "Research", "Permanent", "ClaimedAchievements", "UnlockedZones", "Daily" }) do
        result[k] = clone(d[k])
    end
    result.Expedition = d.Expedition and clone(d.Expedition) or nil
    result.AutoBuyEnabled = d.AutoBuyEnabled == true
    result.PaidBoostEndsAt = d.PaidBoostEndsAt or 0
    result.ProcessedReceipts = clone(d.ProcessedReceipts or {})
    result.EquippedCosmetic = d.EquippedCosmetic
    result.OwnedPasses = clone(d.Runtime.OwnedPasses or {})
    result.PendingOfflineDoubleProductionBonus = d.PendingOfflineDoubleProductionBonus or 0
    return result
end
function Economy:WorldCount(d)
    local n = 0
    for _, z in ipairs(self.Config.Zones) do
        if d.UnlockedZones[z.Id] then
            n += 1
        end
    end
    return n
end
function Economy:AutoBuyUnlocked(d)
    return (d.Research[self.P.AutoBuy.ResearchId] or 0) >= 1
        and self:WorldCount(d) >= self.P.AutoBuy.RequiredWorld
end
function Economy:Zone(d)
    return find(self.Config.Zones, d.CurrentZone) or self.Config.Zones[1]
end
function Economy:BurstMultiplier(d, now)
    return d.Runtime.BurstEndsAt > now and self.P.Burst.Multiplier or 1
end
function Economy:PassMultiplier(d)
    local owned = d.Runtime and d.Runtime.OwnedPasses or {}
    return owned.DoubleProduction == true and 2 or 1
end
function Economy:PaidMultiplier(d, now)
    local multiplier = self:PassMultiplier(d)
    if (d.PaidBoostEndsAt or 0) > now then
        multiplier *= 2
    end
    return multiplier
end
function Economy:BurstDuration(d)
    return self.P.Burst.Duration + (d.Research.Capacity or 0) * 0.75 + (d.Permanent.Power or 0)
end
function Economy:Mastery(d)
    return (1 + d.Prestiges * self.Config.Prestige.MultiplierPerPrestige) * (1 + (d.Permanent.Mastery or 0) * 0.1)
end
function Economy:StellarBonus(d, key)
    local b = d.Runtime and d.Runtime.StellarBonuses or {}
    local value = b[key]
    if key == "OfflineSeconds" then return math.clamp(number(value, 0), 0, 14400) end
    return math.clamp(number(value, 1), 1, 2)
end
function Economy:ClickCore(d)
    local base = self.Config.BaseClickPower
    for _, v in ipairs(self.Catalog) do
        base += v.ClickBonus * (d.Upgrades[v.Id] or 0)
    end
    return base
        * self:Zone(d).Multiplier
        * self:Mastery(d)
        * (1 + (d.Research.Focus or 0) * 0.2)
        * (1 + (d.Permanent.Touch or 0) * 0.25)
        * self:StellarBonus(d, "ClickMultiplier")
        * self:StellarBonus(d, "ProductionMultiplier")
end
function Economy:ClickPower(d, now)
    return self:ClickCore(d) * self:PaidMultiplier(d, now) * self:BurstMultiplier(d, now)
end
function Economy:PassiveCore(d)
    local rate = 0
    for _, v in ipairs(self.Catalog) do
        rate += v.PassivePerSecond * (d.Upgrades[v.Id] or 0)
    end
    return math.min(
        rate
            * self:Zone(d).Multiplier
            * self:Mastery(d)
            * (1 + (d.Research.Efficiency or 0) * 0.15)
            * (1 + (d.Permanent.Automation or 0) * 0.2)
            * self:StellarBonus(d, "PassiveMultiplier")
            * self:StellarBonus(d, "ProductionMultiplier"),
        self.Config.MaximumCurrency
    )
end
function Economy:Passive(d, now, unboosted)
    return math.min(
        self:PassiveCore(d) * self:PaidMultiplier(d, now) * (unboosted and 1 or self:BurstMultiplier(d, now)),
        self.Config.MaximumCurrency
    )
end
function Economy:GameplayEnergyReward(d, baseEnergy, clickCount, incomeSeconds, now)
    baseEnergy = number(baseEnergy, 0, self.Config.MaximumCurrency)
    clickCount = number(clickCount, 0, 1000000)
    incomeSeconds = number(incomeSeconds, 0, 1000000)
    local reward = baseEnergy + self:ClickPower(d, now) * clickCount + self:Passive(d, now, false) * incomeSeconds
    if reward ~= reward then
        return 0
    end
    return math.clamp(reward, 0, self.Config.MaximumCurrency)
end
function Economy:Cost(def, owned, d, producer)
    local price = (def.BaseCost or def.Cost) * (def.CostMultiplier or def.Growth) ^ math.min(owned, 1000)
    if producer then
        price *= 1 - (d.Research.Discount or 0) * 0.02
    end
    return math.max(1, math.floor(math.min(price, self.Config.MaximumCurrency) + 0.5))
end
function Economy:Add(d, amount)
    amount = number(amount, 0, self.Config.MaximumCurrency)
    local earned = math.min(amount, self.Config.MaximumCurrency - d.Currency)
    d.Currency += earned
    d.LifetimeCurrency = math.min(self.Config.MaximumCurrency, d.LifetimeCurrency + earned)
    d.RunEarned = math.min(self.Config.MaximumCurrency, d.RunEarned + earned)
    return earned
end
function Economy:ProductPurchaseNotice(receiptStatus, offer)
    if
        receiptStatus ~= "Granted"
        or type(offer) ~= "table"
        or type(offer.Name) ~= "string"
        or type(offer.Grant) ~= "table"
    then
        return nil
    end
    local grant = offer.Grant
    if grant.Type == "Currency" then
        local amount = number(grant.Amount, 0, self.Config.MaximumCurrency)
        if amount <= 0 or amount % 1 ~= 0 then
            return nil
        end
        return offer.Name .. " purchased: +" .. formatAmount(amount) .. " Energy."
    elseif grant.Type == "PaidBoost" then
        local duration = number(grant.DurationSeconds, 0, self.Config.MaximumCurrency)
        if duration <= 0 or duration % 60 ~= 0 then
            return nil
        end
        local minutes = duration / 60
        return offer.Name
            .. " active for "
            .. minutes
            .. " minute"
            .. (minutes == 1 and "" or "s")
            .. ". It stacks with natural x3 Overdrive."
    end
    return nil
end
function Economy:Notice(d, text, kind)
    d.Runtime.NoticeSerial += 1
    d.Runtime.Notice = text
    d.Runtime.NoticeKind = kind or "Reward"
end
function Economy:ResolvePendingOfflinePassBonus(d, ownsDoubleProduction)
    local pending = number(d.PendingOfflineDoubleProductionBonus, 0, self.Config.MaximumCurrency)
    local earned = 0
    local remaining = 0
    if ownsDoubleProduction then
        earned = self:Add(d, pending)
        remaining = math.max(0, pending - earned)
        d.Runtime.OfflineEarned = math.min(self.Config.MaximumCurrency, (d.Runtime.OfflineEarned or 0) + earned)
    end
    d.PendingOfflineDoubleProductionBonus = remaining
    return earned
end
function Economy:ApplyPassOwnership(d, ownedPasses, resolvePendingOffline)
    local merged = clone(d.Runtime.OwnedPasses or {})
    for key, value in pairs(ownedPasses or {}) do
        if type(value) == "boolean" then
            merged[key] = value
        end
    end
    d.Runtime.OwnedPasses = merged
    if resolvePendingOffline and type(ownedPasses) == "table" and type(ownedPasses.DoubleProduction) == "boolean" then
        self:ResolvePendingOfflinePassBonus(d, ownedPasses.DoubleProduction)
    end
    return merged
end
function Economy:ConfirmPassPurchase(d, passKey)
    if not MonetizationCatalog.Passes[passKey] then
        return false
    end
    d.Runtime.OwnedPasses[passKey] = true
    if passKey == "DoubleProduction" then
        self:ResolvePendingOfflinePassBonus(d, false)
    end
    return true
end
function Economy:InitializeSession(d, now, ownedPasses, applyOffline, ownershipUnknown)
    self:ApplyPassOwnership(d, ownedPasses, false)
    d.Runtime.AutoTapAccumulator = 0
    if applyOffline then
        self:Offline(d, now, ownershipUnknown == true)
    end
    if type(ownedPasses) == "table" and type(ownedPasses.DoubleProduction) == "boolean" then
        self:ResolvePendingOfflinePassBonus(d, ownedPasses.DoubleProduction)
    end
end
function Economy:Offline(d, now, ownershipUnknown)
    local hours = self.P.Offline.Hours + (d.Research.Storage or 0) * 0.5 + (d.Permanent.Clock or 0)
        + self:StellarBonus(d, "OfflineSeconds") / 3600
    local seconds = math.clamp(now - d.LastSeen, 0, math.min(hours, 24) * 3600)
    if seconds >= 60 then
        local startAt = now - seconds
        local boosted = math.clamp((d.PaidBoostEndsAt or 0) - startAt, 0, seconds)
        local baseAmount = self:PassiveCore(d) * (seconds + boosted) * self.P.Offline.Efficiency
        local multiplier = self:PassMultiplier(d)
        local amount = baseAmount * multiplier
        local currencyBefore = d.Currency
        d.Runtime.OfflineEarned = self:Add(d, amount)
        d.Runtime.OfflineSeconds = seconds
        if ownershipUnknown and multiplier == 1 then
            local fullAmount = math.min(baseAmount * 2, math.max(0, self.Config.MaximumCurrency - currencyBefore))
            local pending = math.max(0, fullAmount - d.Runtime.OfflineEarned)
            d.PendingOfflineDoubleProductionBonus =
                math.min(self.Config.MaximumCurrency, (d.PendingOfflineDoubleProductionBonus or 0) + pending)
        end
    end
    d.LastSeen = now
end
function Economy:Metric(d, metric)
    if metric == "Clicks" then
        return d.TotalClicks
    elseif metric == "Earned" then
        return d.LifetimeCurrency
    elseif metric == "Trips" then
        return d.TotalExpeditions
    elseif metric == "Rebirths" then
        return d.Prestiges
    elseif metric == "Purchases" then
        return d.LifetimePurchases
    elseif metric == "Worlds" then
        return self:WorldCount(d)
    elseif metric == "Owned" then
        local n = 0
        for _, v in pairs(d.Upgrades) do
            n += v
        end
        return n
    end
    return 0
end
function Economy:RebirthCost(d)
    return math.min(
        self.Config.MaximumCurrency,
        self.Config.Prestige.BaseRequirement * self.Config.Prestige.RequirementMultiplier ^ math.min(d.Prestiges, 15)
    )
end
function Economy:RebirthGain(d)
    local maximum =
        math.max(1, math.floor(math.sqrt(self.Config.MaximumCurrency / self.Config.Prestige.BaseRequirement)))
    return math.clamp(math.floor(math.sqrt(d.RunEarned / self.Config.Prestige.BaseRequirement)), 1, maximum)
end
-- Shared purchase path keeps manual and automatic spending under identical gates.
function Economy:BuyProducer(d, def, limit)
    if self:WorldCount(d) < (def.RequiredWorld or 1) then
        return 0
    end
    local bought = 0
    for _ = 1, limit do
        local owned = d.Upgrades[def.Id] or 0
        if owned >= 100000 then
            break
        end
        local cost = self:Cost(def, owned, d, true)
        if d.Currency < cost then
            break
        end
        d.Currency -= cost
        d.Upgrades[def.Id] = owned + 1
        bought += 1
        d.LifetimePurchases += 1
    end
    return bought
end
function Economy:Tick(d, now, dt)
    if d.Daily.Day ~= math.floor(now / 86400) then
        self:ResetDaily(d, now)
    end
    local elapsed = math.clamp(dt, 0, 5)
    local startAt = now - elapsed
    local boundaries = { startAt, now }
    for _, endsAt in ipairs({ d.Runtime.BurstEndsAt or 0, d.PaidBoostEndsAt or 0 }) do
        if endsAt > startAt and endsAt < now then
            table.insert(boundaries, endsAt)
        end
    end
    table.sort(boundaries)
    local amount = 0
    local base = self:PassiveCore(d)
    for i = 1, #boundaries - 1 do
        local fromAt, toAt = boundaries[i], boundaries[i + 1]
        local mid = (fromAt + toAt) * 0.5
        amount += base * self:PaidMultiplier(d, mid) * self:BurstMultiplier(d, mid) * (toAt - fromAt)
    end
    self:Add(d, amount)
    if d.Runtime.OwnedPasses.DoubleProduction == true and (d.PendingOfflineDoubleProductionBonus or 0) > 0 then
        self:ResolvePendingOfflinePassBonus(d, true)
    end
    if d.Runtime.EventEndsAt > 0 and now >= d.Runtime.EventEndsAt then
        d.Runtime.EventEndsAt = 0
    end
    if now >= d.Runtime.EventNextAt then
        d.Runtime.EventEndsAt = now + self.P.Collectible.Lifetime
        d.Runtime.EventNextAt = now + self.P.Collectible.Interval
        d.Runtime.EventNonce += 1
    end
    if d.AutoBuyEnabled and self:AutoBuyUnlocked(d) then
        d.Runtime.AutoBuyAccumulator = (d.Runtime.AutoBuyAccumulator or 0) + elapsed
        if d.Runtime.AutoBuyAccumulator >= self.P.AutoBuy.Interval then
            d.Runtime.AutoBuyAccumulator %= self.P.AutoBuy.Interval
            -- Buy at most one level per research track each second, in catalog order.
            -- Never buy producers, permanent upgrades, or the Auto Buy unlock itself.
            for _, def in ipairs(self.P.Research) do
                if def.Id ~= self.P.AutoBuy.ResearchId then
                    local level = d.Research[def.Id] or 0
                    if level < def.Max then
                        local cost = self:Cost(def, level, d)
                        if d.Currency >= cost then
                            d.Currency -= cost
                            d.Research[def.Id] = level + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    else
        d.Runtime.AutoBuyAccumulator = 0
    end
end
function Economy:Action(d, action, id, quantity, now)
    if type(action) ~= "string" then
        return false, "Unknown action."
    end
    if d.Daily.Day ~= math.floor(now / 86400) then
        self:ResetDaily(d, now)
    end
    if action == "EquipCosmetic" then
        if not MonetizationRules.CanEquipCosmetic(id, MonetizationCatalog.Cosmetics, d.Runtime.OwnedPasses or {}) then
            return false, "That cosmetic is not unlocked."
        end
        d.EquippedCosmetic = id
        self:Notice(d, "Cosmetic equipped: " .. MonetizationCatalog.Cosmetics[id].Name, "Cosmetic")
        return true
    elseif action == "Click" then
        if d.Runtime.BurstEndsAt <= now then
            d.Runtime.Charge += 1
            if d.Runtime.Charge >= self.P.Burst.Clicks then
                d.Runtime.Charge = 0
                d.Runtime.BurstEndsAt = now + self:BurstDuration(d)
                self:Notice(
                    d,
                    "Overdrive active: natural x"
                        .. self.P.Burst.Multiplier
                        .. " production. It stacks with your paid x2 boost.",
                    "Burst"
                )
            end
        end
        local gained = self:Add(d, self:ClickPower(d, now))
        d.TotalClicks += 1
        d.Runtime.LastClickGain = gained
        return true
    elseif action == "AutoBuy" then
        if type(id) ~= "boolean" then
            return false, "Invalid Auto Buy setting."
        end
        if id and not self:AutoBuyUnlocked(d) then
            return false, "Auto Buy requires 8 worlds and the 500M Energy Research upgrade."
        end
        d.AutoBuyEnabled = id
        d.Runtime.AutoBuyAccumulator = 0
        self:Notice(
            d,
            id and "Auto Buy enabled. Research upgrades buy automatically every second."
                or "Auto Buy paused. Save Energy for your next goal.",
            "Confirm"
        )
        return true
    elseif action == "Buy" then
        local def = find(self.Catalog, id)
        if not def then
            return false, "Unknown producer."
        end
        if self:WorldCount(d) < (def.RequiredWorld or 1) then
            return false, "Unlock more worlds first."
        end
        local limit = quantity == "Max" and 100 or quantity == 10 and 10 or 1
        local bought = self:BuyProducer(d, def, limit)
        if bought == 0 then
            return false, "Not enough " .. string.lower(self.Config.Currency.Name) .. "."
        end
        self:Notice(
            d,
            "Purchased " .. bought .. " " .. ((self.Config.UpgradePresentation[id] or {}).Name or id),
            "Purchase"
        )
        return true
    elseif action == "Zone" then
        local z = find(self.Config.Zones, id)
        if not z then
            return false, "Unknown world."
        end
        if not d.UnlockedZones[id] then
            if d.Currency < z.UnlockCost then
                return false, "Not enough to unlock " .. z.Name .. "."
            end
            d.Currency -= z.UnlockCost
            d.UnlockedZones[id] = true
            self:Notice(d, z.Name .. " unlocked! x" .. z.Multiplier .. " production", "World")
        end
        d.CurrentZone = id
        return true
    elseif action == "Research" or action == "Permanent" then
        local defs = self.P[action]
        local def = find(defs, id)
        if not def then
            return false, "Unknown upgrade."
        end
        local level = d[action][id] or 0
        if level >= def.Max then
            return false, "Already at maximum level."
        end
        if action == "Research" and id == self.P.AutoBuy.ResearchId
            and self:WorldCount(d) < self.P.AutoBuy.RequiredWorld then
            return false, "Own " .. self.P.AutoBuy.RequiredWorld .. " worlds before buying Auto Buy."
        end
        local cost = self:Cost(def, level, d)
        local wallet = action == "Permanent" and "Stars" or "Currency"
        if d[wallet] < cost then
            return false,
                "Not enough " .. (wallet == "Stars" and "stars" or string.lower(self.Config.Currency.Name)) .. "."
        end
        d[wallet] -= cost
        d[action][id] = level + 1
        if action == "Research" and id == self.P.AutoBuy.ResearchId then
            d.AutoBuyEnabled = true
            d.Runtime.AutoBuyAccumulator = 0
            self:Notice(d, "Auto Buy permanently unlocked! It buys research; pause it in Research to save Energy.", "Research")
        else
            self:Notice(d, def.Name .. " upgraded to level " .. (level + 1), "Research")
        end
        return true
    elseif action == "Expedition" then
        if d.Expedition then
            return false, "Finish your current expedition first."
        end
        local def = find(self.P.Expeditions, id)
        if not def then
            return false, "Unknown expedition."
        end
        if self:WorldCount(d) < def.World then
            return false, "Unlock more worlds first."
        end
        if d.Currency < def.Cost then
            return false, "Not enough to launch this expedition."
        end
        local multiplier = (1 + (d.Research.Logistics or 0) * 0.15) * (1 + (d.Permanent.Cargo or 0) * 0.25)
        local baseReward = self:GameplayEnergyReward(d, def.Reward, def.ClickCount or 0, def.IncomeSeconds or 0, now)
        local reward = math.min(self.Config.MaximumCurrency, baseReward * multiplier)
        d.Currency -= def.Cost
        d.Expedition = { Id = id, EndsAt = now + def.Duration, Reward = reward }
        self:Notice(d, def.Name .. " is on its way.", "Expedition")
        return true
    elseif action == "ClaimExpedition" then
        if not d.Expedition or now < d.Expedition.EndsAt then
            return false, "Your expedition is still traveling."
        end
        local reward = d.Expedition.Reward
        d.Expedition = nil
        self:Add(d, reward)
        d.TotalExpeditions += 1
        self:Notice(d, "Expedition complete! Cargo collected.", "Reward")
        return true
    elseif action == "Achievement" or action == "Daily" then
        local def = find(action == "Daily" and self.P.Daily or self.P.Achievements, id)
        if not def then
            return false, "Unknown reward."
        end
        local claimed = action == "Daily" and d.Daily.Claimed or d.ClaimedAchievements
        local metric = self:Metric(d, def.Metric) - (action == "Daily" and (d.Daily.Baseline[def.Metric] or 0) or 0)
        if claimed[id] then
            return false, "Reward already collected."
        end
        if metric < def.Goal then
            return false, "Objective is not complete yet."
        end
        claimed[id] = true
        self:Add(d, self:GameplayEnergyReward(d, def.Energy or 0, def.ClickCount or 0, def.IncomeSeconds or 0, now))
        d.Stars = math.min(self.Config.MaximumCurrency, d.Stars + (def.Stars or 0))
        self:Notice(d, def.Name .. " reward collected!", "Achievement")
        return true
    elseif action == "Collect" then
        if d.Runtime.EventEndsAt <= now or id ~= d.Runtime.EventNonce then
            return false, "That bonus has passed."
        end
        d.Runtime.EventEndsAt = 0
        self:Add(d, self:GameplayEnergyReward(d, 25, 10, 15, now))
        self:Notice(d, "Bonus collected!", "Collect")
        return true
    elseif action == "Rebirth" then
        if not self.Config.Prestige.Enabled or d.Currency < self:RebirthCost(d) then
            return false, "You need more Energy for Ascension."
        end
        local stars = self:RebirthGain(d)
        d.Stars = math.min(self.Config.MaximumCurrency, d.Stars + stars)
        d.Prestiges += 1
        d.Currency = 0
        d.RunEarned = 0
        d.Upgrades = {}
        -- Auto Buy is a permanent research unlock; keep its level and on/off preference.
        local autoBuyResearchId = self.P.AutoBuy.ResearchId
        local autoBuyLevel = d.Research[autoBuyResearchId] or 0
        d.Research = { [autoBuyResearchId] = autoBuyLevel }
        d.Runtime.AutoBuyAccumulator = 0
        d.Runtime.Charge = 0
        d.Runtime.BurstEndsAt = 0
        self:Notice(d, "Ascension complete! +" .. stars .. " stars. Permanent upgrades are waiting.", "Rebirth")
        return true
    end
    return false, "Unknown action."
end
function Economy:Snapshot(d, now, saveMode, profileWritable)
    local canSellDeveloperProducts, productsUnavailableReason =
        MonetizationRules.DeveloperProductAvailability(profileWritable, d.Runtime.ReceiptLedgerBytes or 2)
    local s = {
        Currency = d.Currency,
        LifetimeCurrency = d.LifetimeCurrency,
        RunEarned = d.RunEarned,
        TotalClicks = d.TotalClicks,

local Legacy = {}

function Legacy.Commit(store, userId, sessionId, profileSnapshot, offer, purchaseId, gameNow, leaseNow, maxCurrency, leaseSeconds, maxProfileCharacters)
	maxProfileCharacters = type(maxProfileCharacters) == "number" and maxProfileCharacters > 0 and maxProfileCharacters or MAX_PROFILE_CHARACTERS
	if not store or type(store.UpdateAsync) ~= "function"
		or type(userId) ~= "number" or type(sessionId) ~= "string"
		or type(profileSnapshot) ~= "table" or type(offer) ~= "table" or offer.Kind ~= "Product"
		or type(offer.Id) ~= "number" or offer.Id <= 0 or offer.Id % 1 ~= 0
		or type(purchaseId) ~= "string" or type(leaseNow) ~= "number"
		or type(leaseSeconds) ~= "number" or leaseSeconds <= 0 then
		return "Retry"
	end

	local callbackStatus
	local ok, saved = pcall(function()
		return store:UpdateAsync("User_" .. tostring(userId), function(old)
			if type(old) ~= "table" then
				callbackStatus = "Retry"
				return nil
			end
			if old.Version ~= nil and old.Version ~= 1 and old.Version ~= 2 then callbackStatus = "Retry"; return nil end
			local lease = old._Session
			if type(lease) ~= "table" or lease.Id ~= sessionId
				or type(lease.ExpiresAt) ~= "number" or lease.ExpiresAt <= leaseNow then
				callbackStatus = "Retry"
				return nil
			end

			local oldReceipts = old.ProcessedReceipts
			local existing = type(oldReceipts) == "table" and oldReceipts[purchaseId]
			if existing ~= nil then
				if type(existing) == "table" and existing.Status == "Granted" and existing.PurchaseId == purchaseId
					and (existing.ProductId == nil or existing.ProductId == offer.Id) then
					callbackStatus = "Duplicate"
					return old
				end
				callbackStatus = "Retry"
				return nil
			end

			local updated, result = Rules.ApplyProduct(profileSnapshot, offer, purchaseId, gameNow, maxCurrency)
			if result.Status == "Deferred" then
				callbackStatus = "Deferred"
				return nil
			end
			if result.Status == "Invalid" then
				callbackStatus = "Invalid"
				return nil
			end
			if result.Status == "Duplicate" then
				updated._Session = { Id = sessionId, ExpiresAt = leaseNow + leaseSeconds }
				callbackStatus = "Duplicate"
				return updated
			end
			if result.Status ~= "Granted" then
				callbackStatus = "Retry"
				return nil
			end

			updated._Session = { Id = sessionId, ExpiresAt = leaseNow + leaseSeconds }
			local encodedOk, encoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(updated) end)
			if not encodedOk or #encoded > maxProfileCharacters then
				callbackStatus = "Capacity"
				return nil
			end
			callbackStatus = "Granted"
			return updated
		end)
	end)

	if not ok then return "Retry" end
	if type(saved) ~= "table" then return callbackStatus or "Retry" end
	local receipts = saved.ProcessedReceipts
	local receipt = type(receipts) == "table" and receipts[purchaseId]
	if type(receipt) ~= "table" or receipt.Status ~= "Granted" or receipt.PurchaseId ~= purchaseId then
		return callbackStatus == "Deferred" and "Deferred" or "Retry"
	end
	if callbackStatus == "Duplicate" then return "Duplicate", receipt end
	return "Granted", receipt
end

function UI.Number(n)
	n = math.max(0, tonumber(n) or 0)
	for _, v in ipairs({{1e18,"Qi"},{1e15,"Qa"},{1e12,"T"},{1e9,"B"},{1e6,"M"},{1e3,"K"}}) do
		if n >= v[1] then return (string.format("%.1f", n / v[1]):gsub("%.0$", "")) .. v[2] end
	end
	if n % 1 ~= 0 then return string.format("%.1f", n) end
	return tostring(math.floor(n))
end

-- Draw a silhouette as horizontal vector spans. No external art assets required.
local function polygon(parent, points, color)
	local low, high = 300, 0
	for _, p in ipairs(points) do low = math.min(low, p[2]); high = math.max(high, p[2]) end
	for y = low, high, 2 do
		local xs = {}
		for i, a in ipairs(points) do
			local b = points[i % #points + 1]
			if (a[2] <= y and b[2] > y) or (b[2] <= y and a[2] > y) then
				table.insert(xs, a[1] + (y - a[2]) / (b[2] - a[2]) * (b[1] - a[1]))
			end
		end
		table.sort(xs)
		local edge = math.sqrt(math.max(0, 142^2 - (y - 150)^2))
		for i = 1, #xs - 1, 2 do
			local a, b = math.max(xs[i], 150 - edge), math.min(xs[i + 1], 150 + edge)
			if b > a then
				local span = box(parent, "Land", color)
				place(span, a, y, b - a + 0.3, 2.2)
				gradient(span, color, color:Lerp(C(17, 69, 89), 0.25), 0)
			end
		end
	end
end

    return seconds >= 3600 and string.format("%dh %02dm", math.floor(seconds / 3600), math.floor(seconds % 3600 / 60))

-- Page through complete cards; native wheel/swipe offsets may sit between cards.
function UI.WorldScrollOffset(current, window, canvasSize, stride, direction)
    local maximum = math.max(0, canvasSize - window)
    current = math.clamp(current, 0, maximum)
    if direction == 0 then
        return current
    end
    stride = math.max(1, stride)
    local page = math.max(1, math.floor(window / stride))
    local index = direction > 0 and math.floor(current / stride + 0.001) or math.ceil(current / stride - 0.001)
    return math.clamp((index + direction * page) * stride, 0, maximum)
end

local function paidBoostText(endsAt, now)
    if
        type(endsAt) ~= "number"
        or type(now) ~= "number"
        or endsAt ~= endsAt
        or now ~= now
        or endsAt == math.huge
        or now == math.huge
        or endsAt <= now
    then
        return nil
    end
    local remaining = math.ceil(endsAt - now)
    if remaining <= 0 then
        return nil
    end
    local hours = math.floor(remaining / 3600)
    local minutes = math.floor(remaining % 3600 / 60)
    local seconds = remaining % 60
    local parts = {}
    if hours > 0 then
        table.insert(parts, hours .. "h")
    end
    if minutes > 0 then
        table.insert(parts, minutes .. "m")
    end
    if seconds > 0 or #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, seconds .. "s")
    end
    return "PAID x2 | " .. table.concat(parts, " ") .. " LEFT"
end
UI.PaidBoostText = paidBoostText

function UI.PaidProductionText(state, now)
    if type(state) ~= "table" then
        return nil
    end
    local timedBoost = paidBoostText(state.PaidBoostEndsAt or 0, now)
    local ownsDoubleProduction = type(state.OwnedPasses) == "table"
        and state.OwnedPasses.DoubleProduction == true
    if ownsDoubleProduction then
        if timedBoost then
            return "PAID PRODUCTION x4\nPASS x2 + " .. timedBoost
        end
        return "DOUBLE PRODUCTION PASS: x2"
    end
    return timedBoost
end

    function v:ApplyCosmetic(key)
        if self.AppliedCosmetic == key and self.AppliedCosmeticZone == self.CurrentZone then
            return
        end
        local zone
        for _, candidate in ipairs(Config.Zones) do
            if candidate.Id == self.CurrentZone then
                zone = candidate
                break
            end
        end
        if not zone then
            return
        end
        if self.Art then
            self.Art:Destroy()
        end
        self.Art, self.ArtScale = Art.Planet(self.Target, zone)
        self.ArtScale.Scale = (self.Diameter or 300) / 300
        self.AppliedCosmetic = key
        self.AppliedCosmeticZone = self.CurrentZone
        local palette = cosmeticPalettes[key]
        T.Accent = palette and palette.Accent or defaultAccents.Primary
        T.AccentAlt = palette and palette.AccentAlt or defaultAccents.Secondary
        local accent = palette and palette.Accent or T.AccentAlt
        self.OrbitOutline.Color = accent
        self.OrbitOutline.Transparency = palette and 0.28 or 0.7
        self.OrbitOutline.Thickness = key == "SupporterAura" and 3 or 1
        self.OrbitDot.BackgroundColor3 = accent
        self.SceneTag.TextColor3 = accent
        if not palette then
            return
        end
        local globe = self.Art:FindFirstChild("Globe")
        if palette.Primary and globe then
            globe.BackgroundColor3 = palette.Primary
            local gradient = globe:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
            if gradient then

    function v:UpdateExpeditions(now)
        local s = self.State
        if not s then
            return
        end
        local trip = s.Expedition
        self.Ship.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.08, 0.5)
        self.RouteLabel.Text = "Choose an expedition below"
        for _, r in pairs(self.Cards.Expeditions) do
            local item = r.Item
            if item then
                local enabled = false
                r.Fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
                r.Status.Text = "REWARD " .. Art.Number(item.Reward) .. " " .. Config.Currency.ShortName
                if trip and trip.Id == r.Id then
                    local remaining = math.max(0, trip.EndsAt - now)
                    local progress = 1 - math.clamp(remaining / item.Duration, 0, 1)
                    enabled = remaining <= 0
                    r.Button.Text = enabled and "COLLECT" or formatTime(remaining)
                    r.Status.Text = "CARGO " .. Art.Number(trip.Reward) .. " " .. Config.Currency.ShortName
                    r.Fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(progress, 1)
                    self.Ship.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.08 + 0.84 * progress, 0.5)
                    self.RouteLabel.Text = enabled and "Cargo arrived! Collect your reward below."
                        or item.Name .. " / " .. formatTime(remaining) .. " remaining"
                elseif trip then
                    r.Button.Text = "CREW BUSY"
                elseif item.Locked then
                    r.Button.Text = "LOCKED"
                elseif s.Currency < item.Cost then
                    r.Button.Text = "NEED ENERGY"
                else
                    r.Button.Text = "SEND CREW"
                    enabled = true
                end
                r.Button.Active = enabled
                r.Button.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and T.Accent or T.Panel
                r.Button.TextColor3 = enabled and T.Background or T.MutedText
            end
        end

-- Pure, server-side monetization rules shared with the Studio test harness.
local Rules = {}
Rules.AutoTapInterval = 0.1

local function finite(value)
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value ~= math.huge and value ~= -math.huge
end

local function clone(value, seen)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
	seen = seen or {}
	if seen[value] then return seen[value] end
	local result = {}
	seen[value] = result
	for key, child in pairs(value) do
		result[clone(key, seen)] = clone(child, seen)
	end
	return result
end

local function validProduct(offer)
	return type(offer) == "table"
		and offer.Kind == "Product"
		and finite(offer.Id)
		and offer.Id > 0
		and offer.Id % 1 == 0
		and type(offer.Grant) == "table"
end

function Rules.ExtendBoost(currentEnd, duration, now)
	currentEnd = finite(currentEnd) and math.max(0, currentEnd) or 0
	duration = finite(duration) and math.max(0, duration) or 0
	now = finite(now) and math.max(0, now) or 0
	return math.max(currentEnd, now) + duration
end

function Rules.ApplyProduct(profile, offer, purchaseId, now, maxCurrency)
	local result = clone(profile)
	if type(result) ~= "table" then result = {} end
	if type(result.ProcessedReceipts) ~= "table" then result.ProcessedReceipts = {} end
	local invalid = { Status = "Invalid", PurchaseId = purchaseId }
	if type(purchaseId) ~= "string" or purchaseId == "" or #purchaseId > 128
		or not finite(now) or not validProduct(offer) then
		return result, invalid
	end

	local previous = result.ProcessedReceipts[purchaseId]
	if previous then
		if type(previous) ~= "table" or (previous.ProductId ~= nil and previous.ProductId ~= offer.Id) then
			return result, invalid
		end
		return result, { Status = "Duplicate", PurchaseId = purchaseId, ProductId = offer.Id, Effect = clone(previous.Effect) }
	end

	local grant = offer.Grant
	local effect
	if grant.Type == "Currency" then
		if result.Currency == nil then result.Currency = 0 end
		if not finite(grant.Amount) or grant.Amount <= 0 or not finite(result.Currency) then
			return result, invalid
		end
		maxCurrency = finite(maxCurrency) and math.max(0, maxCurrency) or 1e18
		if grant.Amount > maxCurrency - result.Currency then
			return result, { Status = "Deferred", PurchaseId = purchaseId }
		end
		result.Currency += grant.Amount
		effect = { Type = "Currency", Amount = grant.Amount }
	elseif grant.Type == "PaidBoost" then
		if not finite(grant.DurationSeconds) or grant.DurationSeconds <= 0
			or not finite(grant.Multiplier) or grant.Multiplier <= 1 then
			return result, invalid
		end
		local endsAt = Rules.ExtendBoost(result.PaidBoostEndsAt, grant.DurationSeconds, now)
		result.PaidBoostEndsAt = endsAt
		effect = { Type = "PaidBoost", EndsAt = endsAt }
	else
		return result, invalid
	end

	local receipt = { Status = "Granted", PurchaseId = purchaseId, ProductId = offer.Id, Effect = effect }
	result.ProcessedReceipts[purchaseId] = clone(receipt)
	return result, receipt
end

function Rules.ReconcileReceipt(profile, receipt)
	local result = clone(profile)
	if type(result) ~= "table" then result = {} end
	if type(result.ProcessedReceipts) ~= "table" then result.ProcessedReceipts = {} end
	if type(receipt) ~= "table" or receipt.Status ~= "Granted"
		or type(receipt.PurchaseId) ~= "string" or receipt.PurchaseId == ""
		or type(receipt.Effect) ~= "table" then
		return result
	end
	if result.ProcessedReceipts[receipt.PurchaseId] then return result end

	local effect = receipt.Effect
	if effect.Type == "Currency" and finite(effect.Amount) and effect.Amount > 0
		and finite(result.Currency) then
		result.Currency += effect.Amount
	elseif effect.Type == "PaidBoost" and finite(effect.EndsAt) and effect.EndsAt > 0 then
		result.PaidBoostEndsAt = math.max(finite(result.PaidBoostEndsAt) and result.PaidBoostEndsAt or 0, effect.EndsAt)
	else
		return result
	end
	result.ProcessedReceipts[receipt.PurchaseId] = clone(receipt)
	return result
end

function Rules.ResolvePassOwnership(marketplace, userId, passes, onlyKey, skipKey)
	local owned, unknown = {}, false
	if type(passes) ~= "table" then return owned, true end

	for key, offer in pairs(passes) do
		if (onlyKey == nil or key == onlyKey) and (skipKey == nil or key ~= skipKey) then
			if type(offer) == "table" and finite(offer.Id) and offer.Id > 0 and offer.Id % 1 == 0 then
				local ok, value = pcall(function()
					return marketplace:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(userId, offer.Id)
				end)
				if ok then
					owned[key] = value == true
				else
					unknown = true
				end
			else
				owned[key] = false
			end
		end
	end

	return owned, unknown
end

function Rules.CanEquipCosmetic(key, cosmetics, ownedPasses)
	local cosmetic = type(cosmetics) == "table" and cosmetics[key]
	return type(cosmetic) == "table"
		and type(ownedPasses) == "table"
		and ownedPasses[cosmetic.PassKey] == true
end

function Rules.AdvanceAutoTap(ownedPasses, accumulated, elapsed)
	if type(ownedPasses) ~= "table" or ownedPasses.AutoTap ~= true then return 0, 0 end
	accumulated = finite(accumulated) and math.clamp(accumulated, 0, 0.999999) or 0
	elapsed = finite(elapsed) and math.clamp(elapsed, 0, 1) or 0
	local total = accumulated + elapsed * 10
	local clicks = math.floor(total + 1e-8)
	return clicks, math.max(0, total - clicks)
end

function Rules.ClickFeedback(gain)
	if not finite(gain) or gain <= 0 then return nil end
	return { Kind = "ClickFeedback", Gain = gain }
end

function Rules.DeveloperProductAvailability(profileWritable, receiptLedgerBytes)
	if profileWritable ~= true then return false, "PersistenceUnavailable" end
	if not finite(receiptLedgerBytes) or receiptLedgerBytes >= 3_500_000 then return false, "StorageLimit" end
	return true, nil
end

function Rules.OfferState(offer, hasPrice, owned, active, canFit, canTransact, unavailableReason)
	if type(offer) ~= "table" then return { Status = "Unavailable", CanPrompt = false } end
	if offer.Kind == "Pass" and owned then return { Status = "Owned", CanPrompt = false } end
	if type(offer.Id) ~= "number" or offer.Id <= 0 or offer.Id % 1 ~= 0 or not hasPrice then
		return { Status = "Unavailable", CanPrompt = false }
	end
	if offer.Kind == "Product" and canTransact == false then
		local reason = unavailableReason == "PersistenceUnavailable" and "PersistenceUnavailable" or "StorageLimit"
		return { Status = reason, CanPrompt = false }
	end
	if offer.Kind == "Product" and offer.Grant and offer.Grant.Type == "Currency" and not canFit then
		return { Status = "WalletFull", CanPrompt = false }
	end
	if offer.Kind == "Product" and offer.Grant and offer.Grant.Type == "PaidBoost" and active then
		return { Status = "Active", CanPrompt = true }
	end
	return { Status = "Available", CanPrompt = true }
end

return Rules
